scope: Complete major-component dependency map for the architecture-excellence transformation; source-level, not device acceptance.
dependencyRules: Dependencies point inward toward Domain contracts.
Domain imports Foundation only and owns no platform or infrastructure implementation.
Application coordinates use cases through explicit injected ports.
Infrastructure and Platform implement ports; External integrations are adapters, not owners of application state.
Presentation must not directly execute signing, archive extraction, installation, provisioning or persistence.
Composition is explicit in AppContainer.live(); no new uncontrolled service locator.
Legacy violations are baseline-tracked and must not spread to new files.

coreSystems.name: IdentityManager
coreSystems.responsibility: Certificate/key import, secure storage and status monitoring.

coreSystems.name: ProvisioningValidator
coreSystems.responsibility: Pure compatibility and strict native CMS/profile validation.

coreSystems.name: InstallationCoordinator
coreSystems.responsibility: Install routing, queueing and result verification.

coreSystems.name: DeviceCapabilityResolver
coreSystems.responsibility: Capability answers separated from device trust evidence.

coreSystems.name: PersistentTaskJournal
coreSystems.responsibility: Durable checkpoints, history and recovery records.

coreSystems.name: RepositoryManager
coreSystems.responsibility: Source discovery, ETag refresh and catalog integrity.

coreSystems.name: ArtifactStorage
coreSystems.responsibility: Filesystem artifacts, bounded extraction and atomic staging.

coreSystems.name: BackupRestoreCoordinator
coreSystems.responsibility: Encrypted backup, restore admission and verification.

coreSystems.name: AutomationCoordinator
coreSystems.responsibility: Background grants, Shortcuts and automation entry points.

coreSystems.name: DiagnosticService
coreSystems.responsibility: Redacted structured diagnostics and support exports.

components.name: App shell and composition root
components.responsibilities: Scene lifecycle, explicit dependency graph, environment injection, deep-link dispatch and platform bootstrap.
components.stateOwnership: Owns one AppContainer instance per scene; no duplicated service locator state.
components.concurrencyModel: @MainActor SwiftUI app and @MainActor AppContainer; use cases constructed on demand.
components.persistence: No persistent state; UserDefaults-backed adapters are injected behind ports.
failureModes: environment fallback creating a second container
components.refactoringRequirement: Keep all new dependencies explicit; avoid adding static shared state to AppContainer.

components.name: Presentation views and view models
components.responsibilities: SwiftUI screens, navigation, display state, accessibility, and user intent forwarding.
components.stateOwnership: Transient @State/@StateObject and injected view models; legacy views still use @FetchRequest/Storage.shared.
components.concurrencyModel: Main-actor UI; async work must be delegated; legacy direct file/network work is baseline-tracked.
components.persistence: Legacy Core Data fetch requests and direct Storage calls remain in baseline; new shortcuts are blocked.
components.refactoringRequirement: Incrementally move baseline view coupling behind view models/use cases; do not mass-move files.

components.name: Application use cases and coordinators
components.responsibilities: Coordinate workspace actions, validated transfers, deep links, reset, support and Anisette configuration through explicit contracts.
components.stateOwnership: Per-instance injected closures/services; no global mutable workflow state in refactored use cases.
components.concurrencyModel: @MainActor where UI-facing; async use cases use structured concurrency and cancellation checks.
components.persistence: None directly; adapters own persistence.
components.refactoringRequirement: AnisetteProviderUseCase still imports NativeSigning and is recorded as legacy external-integration coupling; migrate behind a domain port next.

components.name: Domain contracts and value types
components.responsibilities: Framework-free contracts, workspace commands, errors, snapshots, routes and boundary protocols.
components.stateOwnership: Immutable value types and protocol definitions; owns no mutable global state.
components.concurrencyModel: Sendable values and @MainActor-only UI-facing protocols; no concurrency primitives.
components.persistence: No persistence; persistence interfaces are protocols only.
components.refactoringRequirement: Keep Domain pure; add contracts only when an existing workflow needs an explicit seam.

components.name: Unified signing pipeline
components.responsibilities: IPA validation, preflight, identity resolution, signing plan, Zsign execution, output verification and structured diagnostics.
components.stateOwnership: Per-run signing request/options; signed artifacts registered through library services.
components.concurrencyModel: Async structured work with execution gate and cancellation; no main-thread archive processing.
components.persistence: Original/signed IPA files and Core Data library records are written by existing storage adapters.
components.refactoringRequirement: Preserve one pipeline; provider differences belong in identity acquisition and plan inputs, not duplicate engines.

components.name: Native account provisioning and identity
components.responsibilities: Experimental Apple-account authentication, anisette, certificate creation, profile creation and CMS/profile validation.
components.stateOwnership: Account/session repositories and Keychain-backed stores; capability remains .notIntegrated.
components.concurrencyModel: Actors/structured async plus @MainActor managers; strict cancellation/fail-closed CMS gate.
components.persistence: Keychain, resume journal, profile receipt stores; secrets are not in ordinary logs.
components.refactoringRequirement: Do not promote native signing or claim computer-free install without device/CMS evidence.

components.name: Certificate, Keychain and OCSP services
components.responsibilities: P12/profile import, secret storage, certificate health, revocation snapshots and OCSP response verification.
components.stateOwnership: Keychain items and cached status snapshots; no private-key bytes in logs.
components.concurrencyModel: Main-actor status stores; crypto/verifier work is value-based and off the UI path.
components.persistence: Keychain ThisDeviceOnly tiers, Core Data certificate records, UserDefaults status snapshots.
components.refactoringRequirement: Preserve TLS/TLS-validation requirements; do not copy AGPL/GPL validator implementations.

components.name: Provisioning compatibility and nested bundle audit
components.responsibilities: Pure policies for profile/app compatibility, bundle ID matching, nested code discovery and signing-plan validation.
components.stateOwnership: Pure values derived from files; no mutating shared state.
components.concurrencyModel: Synchronous pure functions; safe to call from background inspection tasks.
components.persistence: None; reads plists/files supplied by infrastructure.
components.refactoringRequirement: Keep policies pure; do not let Zsign/UIKit types enter this layer.

components.name: Archive extraction and artifact storage
components.responsibilities: IPA/ZIP inspection, bounded extraction, path-traversal refusal, atomic staging and signed-artifact lifecycle.
components.stateOwnership: Files under Documents directories; temporary staging is bounded and cleaned by existing services.
components.concurrencyModel: Background-safe file operations; atomic replacement and integrity checks before registration.
components.persistence: Filesystem plus Core Data references; large IPA bytes are never embedded in the database.
components.refactoringRequirement: Preserve one archive/artifact owner; do not add a second storage abstraction.

components.name: Application library and lifecycle registry
components.responsibilities: Canonical Core Data records for imported, signed, installed and updated apps; duplicate review and integrity audit.
components.stateOwnership: One persistent store for app lifecycle records; file references are separate from database rows.
components.concurrencyModel: @MainActor Core Data context plus serialized writes; concurrent first-write regression is guarded.
components.persistence: VexSign.xcdatamodeld and Documents artifact directories.
components.refactoringRequirement: Keep one canonical registry; schema migrations require device/simulator rehearsal before uniqueness constraints.

components.name: UnifiedTaskCenter and persistent journal
components.responsibilities: Task IDs, typed progress, cancellation, retry/error classification, checkpoints, recovery and structured task history.
components.stateOwnership: Actor-observable task state plus durable journal files; widgets/Live Activities read snapshots.
components.concurrencyModel: Swift structured concurrency, actor isolation, bounded operations, cancellation propagation.
components.persistence: Atomic journal files and checkpoint records; no blind byte-resume claim.
components.refactoringRequirement: Do not spawn independent progress engines; preserve operation-specific recovery semantics.

components.name: Download and repository management
components.responsibilities: Repository discovery, ETag refresh, validated downloads, package import, transfer control and recovery.
components.stateOwnership: Download list, recovery journal and staged files; library import is a separate transition.
components.concurrencyModel: URLSession delegates, async import, bounded concurrency and cancellation; Live Activity mirrors state.
components.persistence: Filesystem staging and Core Data source records.
components.refactoringRequirement: Keep one download manager; route all URL validation through the security gateway.

components.name: Installation coordinator and capability adapters
components.responsibilities: Capability-driven installation routing, OTA/idevice/container paths, install queue, result verification and device state.
components.stateOwnership: Install queue current entry, capability report and device/pairing/trust states.
components.concurrencyModel: Main-actor observable installers; device work is asynchronous; cancellation/deadline budgets exist.
components.persistence: Pairing files, local TLS identity, manifest URLs, task history and library installation state.
failureModes: transport succeeded but app not installed
components.refactoringRequirement: Do not promise universal computer-free install; capability answers must stay distinct from success evidence.

components.name: Local HTTPS, OTA and Web Manager
components.responsibilities: Device-local HTTPS server, manifest generation, WebDAV/web tools, authorization and URL/SSRF guards.
components.stateOwnership: Server instance, TLS identity, bound port and access tokens; no universal external trust.
components.concurrencyModel: Server event loop / async request handling; iOS-side server start is coordinated on main actor.
components.persistence: Local certificates, source catalogs and request-scoped state.
components.refactoringRequirement: Keep OTA endpoint verification positive and authorization explicit.

components.name: Automation, Shortcuts, widgets and companion targets
components.responsibilities: App Intents, background automation, Live Activities, widget/watch/TV/Vision read-only state surfaces.
components.stateOwnership: Read-only snapshots and user grants; no independent progress engine.
components.concurrencyModel: Main-actor UI surfaces; background task scheduling is platform-limited.
components.persistence: UserDefaults grants, task journal snapshots and shared app-group containers.
components.refactoringRequirement: Keep companion targets read-only; do not duplicate signing/install state.

components.name: Backup, restore and diagnostics
components.responsibilities: Encrypted backup creation, restore admission/verification, diagnostic bundles and redacted structured logs.
components.stateOwnership: Backup archives, restore plans and bounded log buffer; no private keys in exports.
components.concurrencyModel: @MainActor export builders; streaming archive work and crypto are isolated from UI.
components.persistence: Encrypted backup container, integrity metadata, diagnostic archive and log files.
components.refactoringRequirement: Preserve encryption/validation and redaction-before-export; no unauthenticated restore.

components.name: Python backend and repository/web tools
components.responsibilities: Account/premium/catalog-related backend, URL guard, web signer, repo tools and OTA helper endpoints.
components.stateOwnership: Request-scoped state, prepared factories and single-use device-bound keys.
components.concurrencyModel: ASGI async endpoints; deterministic URL validation before network fetch.
components.persistence: Database/cache as configured by server; no secrets in repository defaults.
components.refactoringRequirement: Keep cloud/backend optional; local signing must remain on-device-first.

components.name: TypeScript cloud signing service
components.responsibilities: Optional remote signing job API, queue, isolated worker, digest/HMAC verification and OpenAPI contract.
components.stateOwnership: Job rows, queue state and artifact storage; explicit authorization required.
components.concurrencyModel: Async queue/worker; signatureVerified must be true before success.
components.persistence: Artifact storage, job metadata, HMAC-verified webhooks.
components.refactoringRequirement: Do not describe a configured API as an operational production service.

components.name: EmbeddedContainer and SideSign integrations
components.responsibilities: Experimental guest-host packaging, companion signing bridge and isolated integration adapters.
components.stateOwnership: Availability reports and staged guest artifacts; no duplicated app registry.
components.concurrencyModel: Capability-gated runtime handoff; no universal install promise.
components.persistence: Staged IPA and runtime metadata files.
components.refactoringRequirement: Preserve license obligations and capability gates; no AGPL/GPL source copying.

components.name: NimbleKit, AltSourceKit and vendored dependencies
components.responsibilities: Local utility/UI extensions, AltStore-compatible source parsing, zsign and device bridge packages.
components.stateOwnership: Pin files and package graphs; no package introduced merely for appearance.
components.concurrencyModel: Package-level concurrency; adapters isolate platform calls.
components.persistence: Package.resolved pins and vendored source/licenses.
components.refactoringRequirement: Preserve pins and third-party notices; no new Swift package for folder aesthetics.

components.name: Xcode project, workspace and build configurations
components.responsibilities: App/tests/widget/watch/TV/Vision targets, file-system-synchronized groups, signing-disabled CI build and SwiftPM pins.
components.stateOwnership: Build settings and target membership; no runtime mutable state.
components.concurrencyModel: Build-time configuration; CI selects Xcode and simulator at run time.
components.persistence: Project files and resolved package pins.
components.refactoringRequirement: Do not add separate packages for appearance; new files in synchronized groups need no pbxproj edit.

components.name: GitHub Actions and quality gates
components.responsibilities: CI, platform check, services, docs, release, embedded-container and maintenance workflows; portable policy tests.
components.stateOwnership: Workflow run state and artifacts; no hidden product state.
components.concurrencyModel: Parallel jobs; superseded PR runs are cancelled, main runs are keyed by SHA.
components.persistence: Actions artifacts, build-warnings baseline and check-run annotations.
components.refactoringRequirement: Run portable gates locally; a fresh PR CI run remains the Build-verified gate.

components.name: Distribution, bootstrap and acceptance documentation
components.responsibilities: Honest iOS installation routes, Apple provisioning limits, TestFlight/OTA prerequisites, device acceptance and threat model.
components.stateOwnership: Documentation only; no runtime state.
components.concurrencyModel: Not applicable.
components.persistence: Markdown documents and pinned research reports.
components.refactoringRequirement: Never promote Device-verified status without real iPhone evidence.

components.name: Security, privacy and performance policy suites
components.responsibilities: Cross-file guards for secrets, redaction, TLS, URL policy, archive safety, capability disclosure and performance fixtures.
components.stateOwnership: Baseline JSON files and synthetic fixtures; no product runtime state.
components.concurrencyModel: Offline deterministic checks; no profiling claims without evidence.
components.persistence: Policy baselines and fixture corpora in repository.
components.refactoringRequirement: Use profiling evidence before optimization; preserve all security gates.

sourceReferences.feature: Local signing engine, multi-profile extension signing, cache and OCSP checks
sourceReferences.adaptation: VexSign already vendors zsign; preserve one pipeline and output verification. No README/source code copied.

sourceReferences.feature: Apple ID sign-in, USB/computer trust and developer-profile trust prerequisites
sourceReferences.adaptation: Bootstrap documentation must never promise universal computer-free install.

sourceReferences.feature: iOS 27+ siboot prerequisites, PC-created pairing for older iOS, base64 link staging and log redaction
sourceReferences.adaptation: Use as capability/bootstrap evidence only; custom licence prevents source incorporation.

sourceReferences.feature: Guest-runtime limitations, JIT-less signing, app-extension limitations
sourceReferences.adaptation: Keep EmbeddedContainerRuntime capability-gated; do not copy AGPL source.

sourceReferences.feature: Download-and-sign progress manager with session temp directory
sourceReferences.adaptation: Confirms need for typed progress, cleanup and single owner; VexSign keeps its existing UnifiedTaskCenter/DownloadManager. No source copied.

sourceReferences.feature: OCSP status classification and WWDR intermediate handling
sourceReferences.adaptation: Use as policy comparison only; VexSign retains independent OCSP verifier and TLS/privacy gates. No source copied.

sourceReferences.feature: Pinned 17-repo metadata, licence notes and SideInstaller source inspection
sourceReferences.adaptation: Reused as license-compliant source inventory; no upstream implementation source copied.

assessment: Strong existing layered foundation; architecture-excellence work adds an owner map, drift ratchet and one Application-layer decoupling. Native/CMS, Bootstrap, CI-build and Device-verified gates remain open. Not a 10/10 completion claim.
